'''icebreath Watch Yer Asteroids!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 7 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 WYS icebreath LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Aims to win through drains, direct damage, and a bit of fancy flying through the asteroid fields of Tatooine.

== Strategy ==

Fairly simple, actually... drop the asteroid sectors and make yourself at home!

The Falcon should be your Rycar's Run starship as often as possible, because it's gonna be the hardest ship to get rid of.  With Han, a Freighter Captain, and Special Modifications aboard (not to mention the Few Maneuvers and Light Maneuvers in hand), you can get it up to 13 maneuver (!!!).  Great fun in conjunction with Darklighter Spin!  >;)

Use the Rycar's Runs for retrieval, and do draining and Asteroids Do Not Concern Me to damage.  There's a LOT of maneuver adders here to help keep the dark side from hitting your ships with asteroid destiny.

Card choices:

Home One: Docking Bay - I needed someplace to drop the Fusion Generator Supply Tanks... so now, the only thing that can get rid of the Tanks is a spy.  A spy who will get a pretty nasty beating for boarding Home One without a pass.  >;)

Supply Tanks - adds to the maneuver of my unique starfighters.  'Nuff said.

They'd Be Crazy To Follow Us - You want to come into the asteroids to play?  Muahahahaha... seriously, though; with all four asteroid sectors on table, a tracked 7, and this... you can knock out the Executor with an asteroid destiny draw.  If you can do that to the Executor, you can kill most other starships with ease.

Light Maneuvers - doubles Special Modifications, and cancels a few cards that you might see.

Noble Sacrifice - gotta have an alternative form of retrieval, and this is it.

Special Modifications - Umm... read the card.  >;)

Pretty much just stick to your guns for the most part.  Phylo, Lando, and Talon Karrde can do a quick ground beat if you need it, Leebo can do some direct damage, etc etc etc... you can pretty much figure out why some of the oddball stuff is in here by reading the cards.

Enjoy!

David Kangas

Shadow 31

Ophidian Agent

Vancouver, WA
